academy-students.alt: Students in navy Selrick blazers crowd a bright corridor, with a pink-haired girl and a black-haired boy at the center.
Students seen from behind watch a big display of a violet four-pointed rift in the sky and a small figure flying toward it.
Two Selrick students sit in the dust of a ruined street at sunset, seen past an android's reaching metal hands.

back-to-back.alt: Layla swings her great white cannon one way while Fanny cuts the other way with her blade, the two of them back to back.
Fanny and Layla stand back to back, shoulder to shoulder, seen from below against a sunset sky.

burning-avenue.alt: Ruby holds Angela in her arms in the middle of the burning avenue, with fires and rubble on both sides.

crescents.alt: Chang'e rides her pink crescents beside Lesley as they leap at the gold and black giant over the night city.
A white crescent edged with pink hangs inside a steel test ring held by a robot arm.
Lesley stands on a rooftop with her long rifle while white crescents of light wheel through the smoky sky above the burning towers.

eternal-guards.alt: Vexana holds her staff before a giant Eternal Guard of purple plate whose chest glows with a magenta heart.
A magenta heart crest glows on the chest of an Eternal Guard while a small girl stands before it.

laylas-cannon.alt: Layla swings her long white cannon up with a set face, her pink twin tails behind her.
Layla in a white Selrick corridor aims her long white cannon, its muzzle glowing blue.
A white-blue streak of cannon fire flashes past Fanny and bursts an Ender into a cloud of pink light.

vexanas-staff.alt: Vexana holds her staff back to back with Guinevere on a smoky street as clawed Enders close in.
Vexana fires a bolt of light from her staff into an Ender while Guinevere leaps with her fist thrown beside her.
Vexana raises her staff on a ruined platform under a storm sky, violet blades behind her head and gray Enders around her.

academy-uniform.alt: Selena in her white school uniform and blue tie smiles with one finger on her lips, small red horns in her blonde hair.
Students in school uniform walk toward the academy plaza on a bright day.
Vexana in her white school uniform with a purple tie and skirt reaches toward the viewer, a staff in her other hand.

small-flying-craft.alt: Small craft fly through the smoke above a burning city of towers while Lesley watches from a high rooftop ledge at night.

angelas-awakening.alt: Angela, pink-haired with white cat-ear headgear, hangs in a frame of cables with her eyes open.
Angela stands awake on her pedestal in the Laboratory, held by cables and robot arms, before a window full of stars.

chocolate-day.alt: Chibi Fanny stands at a classroom door with her back turned while Layla, holding a pink gift box, watches from the edge of the frame.

day-the-newcomers-became-aspirants.alt: In the Academy hall under tall star-shaped windows, Guinevere waves her whole arm at Vexana by the door while a group stands far off at the front.

ender-core.alt: Design sheet of gray, clawed Enders drawn to scale beside a small human, with one torso opened on a glowing core.

old-tower.alt: Lesley stands in a high window at night with her long rifle across her body and the moon over the city behind the glass.

promise-on-the-roof.alt: Guinevere holds up her phone for a selfie with Vexana on a sunny rooftop above the city, a gold star pin at each collar.

rooftop-talk.alt: Layla raises her white cannon toward the night sky with a smile while Fanny smiles behind her.

seawall.alt: Four girls stand on a ruined waterfront below a huge four-pointed tear of violet light in the sky.

silverbolts-first-run.alt: Silverbolt's silver dragon head, jaws open and one eye glowing blue, wreathed in blue lightning against a cloudy sky.

vexanas-stand-in-the-ring.alt: Vexana leaps and fires her staff on the ruined platform as violet blades flare behind her and a tall Ender closes in.

academy-roofs.alt: Chibi Layla spreads her arms on an Academy roof as 10 POINTS flashes above her and students cheer behind the rail.

welcome-to-terrinia-billboard.alt: A ring of fire burns through the hole in a dark billboard, its WELCOME TO lettering partly cut off by the frame.

two-students-in-dark-cloaks.alt: Two Selrick students in dark cloaks sit on cracked ground as armored android hands reach toward them in pink light.
